observation.command:
cd /workspace
runuser -u dev -- ddev exec sh -c 'curl -sL http://localhost/ -o /tmp/home.html; grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/home.html | head -1; grep -c "openculturas" /tmp/home.html'
echo "=== drush core:version ==="
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush core:version 2>&1 | head -3
echo "=== node count ==="
cat > /tmp/nodes.php <<'EOF'
echo 'node count: ' . \Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('node')->getQuery()->count()->execute();
EOF
runuser -u dev -- ddev drush php-eval "$(cat /tmp/nodes.php)" 2>&1 | tail -2
